teaser: The sound of a ball hitting asphalt, again and again, before anyone else has shown up to play, is a fair picture of what life path 5 feels like inside an ENTJ. Both arrive early, both move before the game officially starts, chasing whatever action is available before the morning has properly begun. Most numbers crossed with this type argue about whether to move or wait. Here the argument is different: everything in the room leans toward motion at once, so the daily negotiation isn't whether to open a door but which door gets opened first, and how fast the next one follows it.
